ideas: New object: Bouncy star shape with high restitution
New chaos button: Black hole — sucks everything toward center
Visual: Confetti burst when objects collide hard
upgrades.summary: Added bouncy star tool (⭐) with 0.95 restitution in random colors, Black Hole chaos button that sucks all objects to center for 5 seconds then flings them outward with a purple accretion disk visual, and confetti burst system that showers colorful tumbling confetti on hard impacts with screen shake.

ideas: New object: Balloon that floats upward with anti-gravity
New chaos button: Anti-gravity pulse — everything floats up briefly
Visual: Object trails/afterimages that fade
upgrades.summary: Added Balloon tool (🎈) that floats upward with buoyancy physics and gentle drift, with colorful oval rendering and swaying string. Anti-Gravity Pulse (FLOAT) chaos button reverses gravity for 4 seconds with sparkle particles and a satisfying drop when it ends. Speed trails system that renders glowing afterimages behind fast-moving objects for a slick motion-blur feel.

ideas: Interactive: Portals — two linked circles that teleport objects
New chaos button: Time warp — slow-motion toggle for 5 seconds
New chaos button: Rain — spawn 20 random small objects from the top
upgrades.summary: Added Portal tool (🌀) — tap twice to place a linked portal pair, objects entering one teleport out the other with exit particles and sound. Time Warp (SLO-MO) chaos button slows physics to 20% speed for 5 seconds with purple vortex overlay, vignette, and pulsing label. Rain chaos button (🌧️) drops 20 random objects from the sky in a staggered cascade for instant chaos.

ideas: Interactive: Pinball bumpers that light up on hit
New object: Beach ball — huge, light, super bouncy
New chaos button: Gravity flip — gravity rotates 90° each press
upgrades.summary: Added Pinball Bumpers (🔴) — place static bumpers that flash white and blast objects away on contact with particle bursts and satisfying pings. Beach Ball (🏖️) tool spawns huge, lightweight, super-bouncy balls with colorful striped panels and a glossy shine. Gravity Flip (G-FLIP) chaos button rotates gravity 90° each press (down→right→up→left) with a directional label flash and screen shake.

ideas: New object: Rubber duck that squeaks on impact
New chaos button: Mega bounce — temporarily max out all restitution
Easter egg: Konami code activates ultra-chaos mode
upgrades.summary: Added Rubber Duck tool (🦆) — yellow duck that squeaks on every impact with cute particles and custom sound. Mega Bounce (🏀) chaos button maxes all restitution to 1.2 for 5 seconds — everything becomes a super ball with green particle burst and timer bar. Konami Code easter egg (↑↑↓↓←→←→BA) triggers 10 seconds of ULTRA CHAOS — random explosions, object spawns, gravity nudges, screen-shaking rainbow tint, and a massive particle burst.

ideas: New object: Domino tile for chain reactions
New chaos button: Vortex — spins all objects around a center point
Visual: Lightning bolt between close fast-moving objects
upgrades.summary: Added Domino tile (🀄) — tall, thin tiles perfect for chain reactions with retro dot markings. Vortex (🌀) chaos button spins all objects around center with tangential force + inward pull for 5 seconds, purple swirl rings and particles. Lightning bolts — jagged electric arcs spark between nearby fast-moving objects with cyan glow, adding dramatic visual energy to high-speed chaos.

ideas: New chaos button: Tornado — funnel that moves across screen
New object: Anvil — extra heavy, smashes through everything
Visual: Fire trail on objects moving faster than threshold
upgrades.summary: Added Tornado (🌪️) chaos button — a funnel sweeps across the screen for 6 seconds, sucking objects upward and spinning them with debris particles. Anvil tool (🔨) spawns ultra-heavy anvils that smash through everything with satisfying weight. Fire trails blaze behind any object moving fast enough — yellow-to-red gradient flames that scale with speed.

ideas: Interactive: Trampoline platform with extra bounce
New chaos button: Freeze — all objects stop instantly then resume
Visual: Pixel dust cloud when objects land hard
upgrades.summary: Added Trampoline tool (🟩) — place static bounce pads that launch objects skyward with spring particles and a satisfying boing sound. Freeze (🧊) chaos button instantly freezes all objects in place for 3 seconds with ice crystal particles and blue frost overlay, then everything resumes with a dramatic thaw burst. Pixel dust clouds poof up when objects slam into walls/floor — brown/tan expanding puffs that add weight and impact to every hard landing.

ideas: Interactive: Conveyor belt surface that moves objects along it
Game mode: Popcorn — objects randomly pop upward every few seconds
Visual: Screen flash and chromatic aberration on big impacts
upgrades.summary: Added Conveyor Belt tool (⏩) — place static belts with animated chevrons that push objects left or right via surface friction. Popcorn (🍿) chaos button makes random objects pop upward for 8 seconds with butter-yellow particles and bounce sounds. Chromatic aberration — hard impacts and explosions now trigger RGB channel splitting and white screen flash for dramatic visual punch.

ideas: New object: Wrecking ball on a chain constraint
New chaos button: Shuffle — randomize all object positions
Game mode: Destruction meter — counts total energy released
upgrades.summary: Added Wrecking Ball tool (⚫) — heavy iron ball swinging on a chain from a static anchor point with metallic rendering and chain-link visuals. Shuffle (🔀) chaos button teleports every dynamic object to a random other object's position with orange burst particles, instant chaos. Destruction Meter HUD (bottom-left) tracks cumulative collision energy with 7 escalating ranks from CALM to GODLIKE, log-scale progress bar, and color-coded labels.
